data.exact_reserve_text: During the year, the Syndicate released GBP 2.6m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2015: GBP 8.7m) arising predominantly from the nuclear liability class.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2016 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 34.662m. During 2016 it released GBP 2.6m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods, a favourable prior-year development (approximately 7.5% of opening gross reserves) arising predominantly from the nuclear liability class.
raw_causal_phrases: released GBP 2.6m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2015: GBP 8.7m) arising predominantly from the nuclear liability class.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding, 2015 comparative column). Prior-year movement is reported in narrative note 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' as a GBP 2.6m release; the note does not present a numeric table differentiating gross vs net but the wording implies gross technical reserves movement and has been used as the primary PYD source. Claims development triangle is present (gross) on page 26 which could be used for cross-checks.
